description.value: Settlements across the Combine and the Slums alike know your name as the one that saves people the clinics give up on. Once per day, you can Treat Wounds on a creature that has died within the last minute, restoring it to 1 Hit Point and the dying condition instead of leaving it dead, as if by a desperate, mundane miracle.

cinderfall.incomplete: Reviving a creature dead within the last minute back to the dying condition via Treat Wounds has no engine hook -- there is no rule element that reverses the dead state.
